keep.label: Keep it
keep.blurb: Your 80% lands in your wallet every 15 minutes, in the pair token.

split.label: Split
split.blurb: Your 80% is forwarded to up to 5 wallets by weight every 15 minutes.

holders.label: Holder rewards
holders.blurb: Choose how much of your 80% goes to holders (by balance) and how much to you. Paid every 30 minutes once the pot is worth $10, to the top 2,000 wallets holding at least 0.005% of supply, in the pair token or SOL.

burn.label: Buyback & burn
burn.blurb: Your 80% buys the token back and burns it every 5 minutes.

dip.label: Dip Defender
dip.blurb: Your 80% fills a war chest in the pair token. The keeper only buys and burns when the price is a chosen % below its 24h high. The coin buys its own dip.

bounty.label: Top Buyer Bounty
bounty.blurb: Every 15 minutes the 3 biggest net buyers of the round split your 80% (50 / 30 / 20), paid in the pair token. A volume engine.

deep.label: Deep Pool
deep.blurb: Your 80% becomes your own liquidity. On the curve it pays holders; after graduation, 70% is zapped into your DAMM v2 pool as permanent depth and 30% funds a Meteora reward stream for anyone who adds liquidity next to it. Deeper book, more volume, more fees, back into the book.

lp.label: LP Farm
lp.blurb: Your 80% goes to holders while the coin is on its curve; after graduation it goes to the liquidity providers of the DAMM v2 pool, pro-rata by liquidity, every 30 minutes. Deep liquidity, paid for by the coin itself.

diamond.label: Diamond Hands
diamond.blurb: Holder rewards that grow the longer you hold. Your share is weighted by balance × a tenure multiplier: 1× for the first day, 1.5× after 24 h, 2× after 3 days, 3× after 7 days. Sell any of your bag and your clock restarts at 1×. Same 30-minute round, paid in the pair token.

vault.label: Milestone Vault
vault.blurb: Fees are escrowed in a vault and released to holders only when the coin hits its milestones: a slice of the vault at each market-cap step (2×, 5×, 10× the graduation cap). Miss the deadline and the Council votes: pay it out, burn it, or extend. Fees that pay you when the coin wins.

sister.label: Sister coin
sister.blurb: Your 80% goes to the holders of another Ember coin. A bigger community adopts your launch, or your coin rewards the one it grew out of. Same 30-minute holder round, paid in the pair token.

perp.label: Conviction
perp.blurb: Fees take a position. Your 80% opens a leveraged long or short on the asset your coin believes in: SOL, ETH or wBTC on Jupiter Perps. Profits are harvested every +25% and paid out: half to a holder round, 30% to buy & burn the coin, the rest to burn $EMBER. Base tiers 2× · 3× · 5×.

booster.label: EMBER Booster
booster.blurb: Your 80% buys $EMBER and burns it every 10 minutes, whatever the pair. Rounds under $5 wait for the next one. Every trade of your coin makes $EMBER scarcer.

lotto.label: SuperLotto
lotto.blurb: Your 80% fills a pot. Every 30 minutes 10 holders share four fifths of it. Odds scale with √balance, so small bags win too. The last fifth rolls into a Daily Jackpot: one holder takes it all at 00:00 UTC. Verifiable draws seeded by a finalized blockhash. 3% tax only.

fomo.label: fomode👀
fomo.flameBlurb: Flame: the same trader gets 50% or 60% of the supply at graduation instead of 10% (Flame 50 / Flame 60, your pick), and every fee goes to the holders, pro-rata, every 15 minutes. Nobody else is paid: not you, not the trader. Fixed: 2% tax, $40K graduation.
fomo.blurb: Nothing to you: 80% of what Ember claims goes to one trader on the FOMO leaderboard, picked by X handle. Their wallet comes from fomo.family, not from a form, and is paid automatically every 15 minutes, on the curve and after graduation. At graduation 10% of the supply is airdropped to them. Fixed: 2% tax, $40K graduation.

basket.label: Stock Basket
basket.blurb: SOL or USDC pairs only, nothing to the creator: 95% of what Ember claims fills a pot, 5% is the platform's. Every hour the pot buys the basket you pick at launch (up to 25 tokenized stocks plus ZEC, MET, JUP, HYPE or INJ, 30 at most) and the stocks go to every wallet holding 100,000+ of your coin, by balance. Pushed to wallets automatically, or claimed any time.
